independence: First pass conducted without reading peer reviews. This is a separate context, not an independent model family or independent empirical replication.
scope: Complete readable conversation text was reviewed. Redacted plugin outputs and notebook links were not inspected by this specialist; summary claims of five executions and 39 passing checks remain reported claims here.
mainConclusion: High conceptual breadth, concentrated operational readiness. Strong near-term experimental portfolio combines task-aware equivalence, protocol sufficiency, functional response, writable memory, and counterexample-driven representation repair. Hardware transfer and semantic geometry remain promising proposals with larger untested assumptions.

qualityPolicy.pareto: Use nondomination within a research-object and fidelity stratum. Do not let a simple gauge demonstration dominate a speculative hardware program across incomparable objectives. Preserve weakly supported but potentially distinctive ideas as exploration entries.
gates: specified measurable outcome and explicit comparator
physical/numerical validity appropriate to the claim
fixed evaluation protocol not tuned to archive descriptors
qualityPolicy.missingValues: Unknown evidence/novelty is null or unknown, never zero and never fabricated confidence.
qualityPolicy.intervals: For expert scoring, use adjacent-level ranges or individual reviewer profiles; exact one-point differences should not determine irreversible selection.
qualityPolicy.promotion: Proposal -> executable model test -> robustness -> calibrated material -> physical validation. Promotion requires new evidence, not higher evaluator enthusiasm.
qualityPolicy.scoreUncertainty: Treat each point rating as a reviewer-local central label with a plausible one-level range clipped to 0–4. These are not measured confidence intervals.

diversityAxes.purpose: What is actually being altered or discovered?
Causal response, memory, equivalence, representation repair, communication scheduling, transfer, etc.; one primary family plus secondary tags.
Remove irrelevant distinctions, restore missed distinctions, construct useful behavior, discriminate mechanisms, transfer behavior.
Prevents all phenomena from becoming an eigenspectrum.
Evidence facet/stratum, not a reward for prestige.
Mechanical, photonic, electronic, magnetic, cellular automaton, agent software. Use as facet only unless a substrate changes causal primitives or resource constraints.

dedupRules: Merge aliases, rhetorical restatements, agent-role names, and notebook summaries into their underlying hypothesis/test.
Keep a candidate separate when its intervention, predicted observable, causal alternative, invariance contract, or resource model changes.
Do not merge gauge equivalence, restricted-protocol indistinguishability, approximate functional equivalence, and different physical realizations of a shared reduced mechanism.
Do not count many coordinates as independent diversity dimensions; test redundancy after conditioning on known descriptors.
Store broad programs as parent nodes; specific hypotheses are child entries so a vision is not repeatedly counted through its examples.
Retain both tiny-structure/large-behavior and large-structure/same-behavior pair searches. Neither is guaranteed to be more novel.
coverageLimits: This is coverage of one conversation, not the field or all scientifically possible niches.
The 31 mechanism/program families are an explicit review granularity, not an intrinsic diversity count.
Unvisited grid cells do not establish missing science or valuable search opportunities.
No objective descriptor rank or independence can be inferred from terminology; effective dimension needs empirical data.
No completed Sakana AI Scientist run, physical device advantage, multiagent superiority, or validated ALife-to-material transfer is established by this review.
